description.summary: Utah ranch claiming multiple paranormal phenomena including UFOs, cattle mutilations, poltergeist activity, and cryptids. Commercially exploited and controversial for appropriating Navajo sacred term.
description.full: Skinwalker Ranch is a property in Utah that claims to be the site of extensive paranormal activity including UFO sightings, cattle mutilations, poltergeist phenomena, and cryptid encounters. The ranch gained attention during the Sherman family's ownership (1994-1996) and was subsequently purchased by billionaire Robert Bigelow's National Institute for Discovery Science (NIDS) from 1996-2004. The property has connections to the Pentagon's AAWSAP (Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program). Despite claims of intense investigation, no peer-reviewed scientific evidence has been published substantiating the paranormal claims. The ranch is now owned by Adamantium Real Estate and is the subject of a reality TV series. The name 'Skinwalker Ranch' is controversial as it appropriates a sacred Navajo term (skinwalkers are Navajo witches, not related to this ranch). Critics view it as commercial exploitation with little credible evidence, while proponents claim genuine unexplained phenomena occur there.
